entities.name: Tiana
entities.description: A guardian angel created to protect the Great Machine, who, with Serra's guidance, oversees the Weatherlight's rebuilding and chooses to serve on it.

entities.name: Lyra Dawnbringer
entities.description: A commanding angel from Serra's Realm who tells Tiana her purpose.

entities.name: Afra
entities.description: A cleric who befriends the newly created Tiana.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: The angel who sacrificed herself to heal Benalia and is believed to guide Tiana.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: A martyred Weatherlight captain shown in a portrait.

entities.name: Hadi
entities.description: A Tolarian artificer who works with Tiana to rebuild the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Tien
entities.description: The chief metalworker of the work crew.

entities.name: Farim
entities.description: Hadi's young cousin on the work crew.

entities.name: Mari
entities.description: A sentry of the work crew.

entities.name: Arvad
entities.description: A Benalish knight turned vampire whose compulsion fades near the Powerstone and who saves the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: The artificer away gathering a crew.

entities.name: Molimo
entities.description: A tree spirit whose seed regrows the hull.

entities.name: Phoenix
entities.description: A giant burning raptor that attacks the Weatherlight and is killed by Tiana.

entities.name: The Cabal
entities.description: A death cult that destroyed the town of the Great Machine.

entities.name: Church of Serra
entities.description: The church of angels and clerics.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The skyship being rebuilt.

entities.name: Powerstone
entities.description: The Weatherlight's power source, which eases Arvad's vampirism.

entities.name: Great Machine
entities.description: A vast irrigation machine Tiana was created to guard, destroyed before she arrived.

entities.name: Cathedral of Serra
entities.description: The cathedral where Tiana was created.

entities.name: Bogardan
entities.description: The volcanic coast where the Weatherlight is rebuilt.

entities.name: Aerona
entities.description: Where Arvad was when the Powerstone woke.

entities.name: Serra's Realm
entities.description: The realm from which Lyra and other angels came.

events.summary: Tiana is created in the Cathedral of Serra among angels and clerics.
events.quote: Tiana's first conscious thought came as she stood in the Cathedral of Serra

events.summary: Lyra tells Tiana she was born in answer to mortals' prayers.
events.quote: You are Tiana, and you have been born in answer to the prayers of mortals, for a purpose.

events.summary: Lyra reveals Tiana's purpose is to guard an irrigation system.
events.quote: A very complicated irrigation system.

events.summary: Tiana sees the portrait of Gerrard and his strange spear.
events.quote: The knowledge she had been born with told her that the man with the brown hair and goatee

events.summary: Tiana and the angels find the town and the Great Machine destroyed by the Cabal.
events.quote: They circled around the plateau and Tiana saw what was left of the Great Machine.

events.summary: Lyra attributes the destruction to the Cabal.
events.quote: This is the work of the Cabal.

events.summary: Tiana and Hadi repair the Weatherlight's engines on Bogardan.
events.quote: Tell Tien she wasn't wrong.

events.summary: Tiana realizes Serra feeds her knowledge of the Weatherlight since she revived the Powerstone.
events.quote: It had been happening since she had brought the Powerstone back to life.

events.summary: Tiana drives off a kavu and goblin hunters while guarding the camp.
events.quote: So far she had to drive off a kavu, its tongue aflame, and violently discourage a small hunting party of goblins

events.summary: Farim reports a lone man approaching the camp at night.
events.quote: Mari spotted someone coming.

events.summary: Tiana confronts the traveler and recognizes a vampire in Benalish armor.
events.quote: There was no mistaking what he was.

events.summary: Arvad identifies himself as a captured knight made a vampire.
events.quote: I'm Arvad, Knight of Benalia. I was captured and made a vampire.

events.summary: Arvad says he fights the Cabal and sometimes feeds in battle.
events.quote: I fight the Cabal whenever I can.

events.summary: Arvad says his compulsion lessened the night the Powerstone woke.
events.quote: It was on the night of the full moon, two months ago.

events.summary: Tiana lets Arvad try the Powerstone as a possible cure.
events.quote: It's worth a shot,

events.summary: The crew sees Arvad's fangs have shrunk.
events.quote: Definitely smaller.

events.summary: The crew allows Arvad to stay outside camp under Tiana's watch.
events.quote: he can stay but not in our camp, and you must pledge to watch him.

events.summary: Arvad loses his sensitivity to sunlight under the Powerstone's influence.
events.quote: Under the Powerstone's influence, Arvad had lost his vampiric sensitivity to sunlight

events.summary: Tiana tells Arvad that Jhoira is the legendary one and the legends are true.
events.quote: She is that Jhoira, and those aren't legends, they're all true.

events.summary: Tiana confides that her purpose was destroyed before she arrived.
events.quote: I was supposed to guard a great machine, but it was destroyed before I got there.

events.summary: Arvad tells Tiana she can find a new purpose.
events.quote: Just because your original reason for existence was destroyed doesn't mean you can't get another one.

events.summary: A giant burning phoenix swoops on the Weatherlight camp.
events.quote: Streaking toward them from the mountains was a phoenix.

events.summary: The phoenix burns Tiana, melts her spear and sets tents ablaze.
events.quote: Her spear was a melted lump.

events.summary: Arvad shoots arrows into the phoenix, saving the Weatherlight.
events.quote: Then the phoenix jerked, knocked off its course by an arrow slamming into its neck.

events.summary: Empowered by Serra, Tiana drives her sword into the phoenix and pushes it into the sea.
events.quote: Tiana shot up into the fire and drove her sword in right under its breastbone.

events.summary: Tien credits Arvad with saving the camp and the Weatherlight.
events.quote: Arvad saved us,

events.summary: Tiana resolves to serve on the Weatherlight when Jhoira returns.
events.quote: It wasn't the purpose she had been born for, but it was the one she wanted more than anything.

relations.note: The church had no other use for her.
relations.quote: the only thing the Church of Serra could think of to do with her

relations.note: She drove her sword into its chest.
relations.quote: Tiana shot up into the fire and drove her sword in right under its breastbone.

relations.note: He saved her and the Weatherlight.
relations.quote: I think he saved you, too.

relations.note: He fights the Cabal whenever he can.
relations.quote: I fight the Cabal whenever I can.

relations.note: Lyra is the commander leading the angels and escort.
relations.quote: Commander Lyra wants to take you there herself.

relations.note: They work closely together on the skyship.
The Cabal destroyed the town the angels came to protect.
relations.quote: This is the work of the Cabal.
